subject: POC environment routes & milestones for Healix.ai
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@healix.ai>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@healix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment routes & milestones for Healix.ai

Lena / Carlos — great talk this morning; thanks for the time. Recap and proposed next steps below so we have a concrete plan going into the kickoff. I attached a short mapping spreadsheet that lays responsibilities and a tentative timeline.

High-level options we discussed (pros/cons noted):
- Hosted Redwood API (fastest to start, no infra setup, limited data residency guarantees)
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool in our shared infra for predictable throughput; better isolation; 2–3 day provisioning)
- VPC/Private deployment (customer VPC + private control plane; required for PHI/strict compliance; 2–3 weeks prep for network and KMS)

Healix priorities observed on call: security posture, throughput for batch annotation, and ability to measure latency/quality against our test prompts.

Suggested POC plan (two-phase):
1) Phase 1 (Week 1–2): Hosted trial — rapid integration, run 5k sample documents, gather quality/latency metrics and cost profile.
2) Phase 2 (Week 3–4): If Phase 1 meets acceptance criteria, stand up Dedicated sandbox or VPC pilot to validate sustained throughput and compliance controls.

Proposed success criteria (quick draft) — we should finalize with you on kickoff:
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 300ms for median prompt set
- Throughput: sustained 60 reqs/sec for 60s windows without errors
- Cost: < $0.XX per 1k tokens (baseline; bench in Phase 1)
- Quality: >= 88% pass rate on your labeled prompt set (per Healix scoring)
- Security: confirm logs/audit visibility and KMS integration for Phase 2

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Healix: share a small representative prompt set and the scoring rubric before kickoff (can be sample CSV).
- Healix: confirm if PHI will be in-scope for any subset of the POC. If yes, we should plan for VPC from Phase 2.
- Redwood: internal owners assigned below and we’ll confirm provisioning estimates.

Owners (temporary):
- Redwood lead / initial contact: Ben Carter — overall play / commercial
- Technical integration & metrics: Monica Patel — trial onboarding & success monitoring
- Solution architecture & env selection: Rishi Malhotra — infra feasibility and timeline
- SDR coordination/kickoff: Marissa Cole — scheduling, invites, and prep materials

Proposed kickoff slots (next week): Thu 10/22 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 10/23 14:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot.

Attachments: healix-poc-mapping.xlsx (owner matrix + timeline), redwood-poc-ops-checklist.pdf (ops checklist stub)

Thanks — I’ll queue a calendar invite once you confirm time and preference for Phase 2 approach.

Best,
Ben

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- We can provide the scoring rubric and a 1k-sample prompt CSV by EOD tomorrow.
- PHI: potentially yes for a narrow subset (patient notes). We cannot expose PHI to hosted shared infra, so Phase 2 will need to be VPC if PHI is in-scope. Phase 1 hosted for non-PHI looks fine as a rapid smoke test.
- Throughput: target sustained 50–70 reqs/sec based on our annotation pipeline (bursty). Latency target: <350ms at 95th is acceptable for the POC.

For kickoff, Thu 10/22 10:00 PT works for our engineers. Please send an invite.

Also looping in procurement separately (procurement@healix.ai) to start any required contracting questions once we lock scope; Carlos will coordinate the contract side.

Lena

Thanks all — quick ops readout after sync this morning and follow-up timeline. Summary below is what we can commit to and owners.

Plan (finalized):
- Phase 1 (Hosted smoke test) — Week 1 (Oct 26–30)
  - Deliverables: integration sandbox keys, token-level telemetry enabled, scripted run of 5k sample prompts, quality/latency dashboard (shared link).
  - Owners: Monica (onboarding), Marissa (customer comms)
  - ETA to start: keys + minimal docs within 24 business hours after kickoff; run complete within 3 business days of receiving sample CSV.

- Phase 2 (VPC pilot) — Week 3 (Nov 9–20 window)
  - Deliverables: VPC peering or private link, KMS integration for envelope encryption, dedicated autoscaling sandbox config for throughput tests, compliance evidence snapshot (audit logs).
  - Owners: Rishi (infra), Monica (onboarding support)
  - ETA: provisioning and network validation ~10–12 business days after we receive Healix networking whitelist and KMS details. We’ll confirm exact day-by-day schedule in the runbook.

Acceptance criteria (refined):
- Latency: 95th <= 350ms on your median prompt set during sustained 60s windows
- Throughput: maintain 60 reqs/sec for 60s windows with <=1% error rate
- Quality: >= 88% per your rubric on the holdout set
- Security: KMS key creation and audit log visibility validated in Phase 2

Open / gating items for Healix:
- Provide sample CSV and rubric by Mon 10/26 EOD.
- Provide networking whitelist and KMS contact for Phase 2 by Fri 11/05 to hit Week 3 target.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded the onsite ops checklist and a slim runbook excerpt to the shared drive (link below). Please confirm acceptances and we’ll lock the runbook and calendar milestones.
